plans.title: Scope evidence state that survives between runs
deliverables: An evidence-state artifact owned by a Scope, separate from accepted inputs
Entries carrying claim, status of held, unsupported or open failure, and the run that recorded it
lab start reads existing evidence state and reports what is already known
Verified claims emit named preservation requirements
Tests covering carry-forward, contradiction between runs, and the owner-gate boundary
acceptance_checks: A second Lab run on the same Scope reads the first run's evidence state instead of starting empty
A claim recorded as verified appears as a preservation requirement in a later run's packet
Evidence state cannot become an accepted planning input without the ordinary owner approval
A later run recording a claim that contradicts an earlier held claim is surfaced rather than silently overwriting it

plans.title: Honest acceptance labelling in Lab runs
deliverables: performed_by and evaluated_by fields on a Lab run, mirroring the case contract
The review packet states self_review when the two match
Validation receipts state that they check structural conformance only
Tests asserting a run cannot claim independent acceptance when author and acceptor are the same
acceptance_checks: A run whose author and acceptor are the same is labelled self_review in the rendered packet
A run claiming independent acceptance with matching actors is rejected
Every validation receipt names its boundary, so a valid receipt cannot be read as an outcome claim
The existing case-record rule and the new Lab rule use the same vocabulary

plans.title: Bounded objective and a defended meta-boundary
deliverables: A declared objective with observable completion conditions, recorded before selection
An explicit exclusion list stating what the run is not covering
The improve-lab module boundary documented as a deliberate invariant with its stability rationale
Tests covering an objective with no completion condition and a run attempting to apply its own proposal
acceptance_checks: A run without observable completion conditions is rejected before selection
The packet shows the declared objective beside what the run excluded
A run proposing a change to the Lab contract still stops at owner_reviewed and applies nothing
The invariant's rationale is recorded where a future editor would encounter it

plans.title: Paired trials and versioned gate criteria
deliverables: A paired-observation artifact holding the mechanism under test with agent, harness, environment and grader fixed
A promotion gate requiring either a paired observation or a recorded reason why one is impractical
Each acceptance gate declares its criteria and the date they last changed
Tests covering an uncontrolled pair, a missing fixed condition, and a gate whose recorded criteria drift from its implementation
acceptance_checks: A paired observation that fails to hold a declared condition fixed is rejected rather than reported as a result
A mechanism promoted without a paired observation carries a recorded reason in the packet
A gate whose declared criteria no longer match its implemented check is reported as drift
The contribution of a mechanism is reported as a difference under fixed conditions, never as an absolute quality claim
